CustomField.description: This field determines the action to be taken when the case reason is logged or changed. It specifies whether to update the existing case, create a new parent or child case, or create a separate orphaned case.
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
"Select an option to define how changes to the case reason should be handled:
'Update Existing Case': Modify the current case with the new reason. 'Create New Parent Case': Initiate a new parent case with the updated reason. 'Create New Child Case': Generate a new child case under the current case. 'Create Separate Orphaned Case': Start a new, independent case with no parent-child relationship.
CustomField.label: Case Reason Handling Type
